blocks.text: Eight people are known to have contracted malaria in the vicinity of Frankfurt Airport in central Germany since July; three of them have died. Those affected are mostly employees of the airport operator Fraport. The Frankfurt Public Health Department believes the outbreak is due to “airport malaria,” which occurs when a female Anopheles mosquito carrying the malaria parasite travels by aircraft to a country where the disease is not common from one where it is, bites a person and infects their red blood cells. “We are dealing with a very rare occurrence, not a new frequent disease in Germany,” said Achim Hörauf, […]...
